name: Cursor
summary: AI code editor with agents, now bundled with xAI's Grok plans.
description: Cursor is an AI-first code editor with agents, tab completion, cloud agents and code review. Its pricing page now presents a shared subscription with Grok and X: the Free plan ($0) has limited AI usage, Plus is $8/month with Grok models only, Premium $30/month adds the latest models and cloud agents, and Super ($100) and Ultra ($200) raise usage. Third-party models are billed separately by usage; it should no longer be listed as Free.
